repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: v0.1.0-beta.7 — clear prices and future charging readiness
release.body:
Beta.7 standardizes **all preferred price displays to øre/kWh with exactly two decimals**, or optional **DKK/kWh with four**. Current/next and requested future-window readiness are independent from historical whole-day coverage. Stored canonical DKK/kWh, full precision, original entity/statistics units, SQLite and read-only CM APIv1 are preserved.

**Prerelease for development HA acceptance.** Source **9eb21fc300f9cfdc39b0e0405364bbf543bfc717**; immutable **v0.1.0-beta.7**. [Draft PR #14](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/pull/14) remains unmerged. Main and all beta.1–.6 releases/tags/assets preserved. Owner authorizes beta.7 prerelease only.

## HACS update

1. Back up development HA. Add `https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine` as HACS custom **Integration** if necessary.
2. Persist **Show beta versions**, refresh information, choose **v0.1.0-beta.7**, download and restart HA. Reload browser/app. Device info must show **0.1.0-beta.7**.
3. Configure the **existing** site. New users first install official HA Nord Pool, then follow **source → confirmed actual grid product → actual fractional supplier markup/VAT**. No simultaneous legacy broker or mandatory dates/monthly fees/heating/product decision.
4. Review current/next readiness and historical coverage separately. **Check future window** selects an exact half-open interval; CM submits its own range to unchanged APIv1. Final prices shows stored current/selected-future components. Advanced → Display unit selects ore2 or DKK4.

[Setup and current/next examples](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.7/docs/WIZARD_GUIDE.md) · [HACS/repair procedure](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.7/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Acceptance checklist](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.7/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md) · [Native/index/migration evidence](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.7/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.7-simulation.json)

## Changes

- Preferred raw spot, current/next final prices, min/max/average, provisional values, Review, current/future breakdowns and stored-slot picker share one site unit and fixed locale-aware precision. Canonical technical entities remain explicitly labelled DKK/kWh with stable IDs, unrounded states and Recorder/statistics units. Separate fixed-unit display identities prevent reinterpretation of history.
- English/British-English/Danish and explicit number-format overrides are covered. Browser-system decimal conventions use bundled Intl-derived facts, no optional HA dependency. Raw display labels identify VAT basis. Monetary subtotal/VAT/final figures are independently rounded; totals and cost use full stored precision. Contract entry still preserves0.25/0.50/0.75/3.125ore with point/comma.
- Independent current/next and full-day historical readiness entities/diagnostics. A late22:15CET activation can show7/96 historical quarters INCOMPLETE, current/next/window READY and96/96 tomorrow READY. Earlier missing prices stay absent. A requested window is READY only when every slot has verified final prices; missing/unpublished/stale/error/provisional data never becomes zero or READY. The UI48h picker is no API horizon limit or charging plan.
- Established engine/SQLite/API/schedules/source normalizers preserved. Each stored UTC quarter retains final amount, original normalized spot/applied components, source/verification and revision. Live API uses immutable startup-loaded indexed slices; no provider fetch, composition, SQLite connection or write on consumer reads. Only changed future records are replaced; settled/unchanged rows and original revisions remain.
- Native beta.6 upgrade preserved15 configs/1,211 original SQL rows/revisions/315 entity IDs/29 Recorder statistics-unit metadata rows. Unit changes caused no pricing revision. Restart preserved16 configs/1,314rows exactly. Actual released beta.1–.6 migration matrix passes.
- Transparent sample: synthetic100DKK/MWh spot, recorded Radius C winter normal→peak and fictional0.5ore exVAT supplier. Current16:45CET **68.32ore/kWh**, next17:00 **147.95ore/kWh** (optional0.6832/1.4795DKK). Canonical technical prices remain0.683155/1.47946625DKK; supplied planned1.25/2kWh costs **3.81287625DKK**, displayed3.8129. Not a live quote, bill or private contract. Fixed subscriptions excluded; CM owns planning/measurement/control.
- All five local refreshes **13:05,13:20,13:40,23:59,00:01** preserved. Negative prices, Radius TOU/season/midnight,92/96/100-quarter DST, source/component failures, provisional isolation, reset/recovery and stable APIv1 covered. No source/private agreement/heating eligibility guessed. Historical EWII0.030DKK exVAT remains June–September2026 only.

## Validation and integrity

**308 producer tests per core**, HA **2026.10.3 / current2026.10.4**,88% coverage,zero skips,two unchanged upstream HACS warnings. Four unchanged consumer suites153/176/227/228 per core plus two coupled runtime cases/reference/core. All16 exact-source push/PR/tag/draft-updater checks pass before upload. Official hassfest/HACS/translations and both clean package layouts install outside source on both cores. Fresh independent public jobs on both cores re-download actual public metadata/assets/tag/main, run pinned HACS2.0.5/upstream install/update/reinstall and both native layouts, and verify beta6→7 semantic selection. Permanent receipt is recorded only after success.

Native HA2026.10.4/frontend20260930.5 desktop1440×1000/mobile390×844 EN/en-GB/DA tests include actual entity formatting, two/four places, user separators, minimal-system locale, ready/missing windows, selected components, upgrade and restart; zero frontend errors/warnings. Synthetic/recorded boundaries, **not owner real-HA acceptance**.250 repeated range reads on normal/fall/spring cases reject provider fetch, recomposition and SQLite connections; offline SQL confirms the primary-key range index.

ZIP SHA256:
- `ha_energy_price_engine.zip`: `b382f8d06901c72c2a305d9c09d700154d9f326fc8576266d599711fc820987b`
- `ha_energy_price_engine-manual.zip`: `dfdaa771932f011d9aeea8f07a00f932542d4788ef3aede2f89967b1f26d3b73`

## Limits

HA entity/card precision overrides can supersede suggestions; reset to Default or2/4. Old unit-specific display entities remain unavailable after unit switching, preserving history. Canonical technical fields intentionally retain unrounded DKK/kWh. Forms cannot save unsubmitted typing or provide per-page Back. Forms follow user locale; entity names follow registry/system language. HACS external brand catalog may fall back.

Automatic DSO starts Radius C; other products/future national periods need verified rules. New sites can have partial first days. Actual private terms/provider availability/heating eligibility and hardware remain owner acceptance. Cloud35,136rows/18.24MB,96-row append.0302s/reload1.599s/indexedlookup11.51µs retain original touched-row design; **cloud benchmarks do not establish Raspberry Pi performance**. History remains in RAM for APIv1.

No production HA, Node-RED, CM or physical charging changes. No main merge or stable release. Stop after beta.7 publication, independent verification and permanent handoff.
